name: upload-retried
description: Sumo throttles routinely, and a 429 means the batch was rejected UNPROCESSED -- the one upload failure a healthy configuration meets under load. The batch POST goes through post_json with retry_on=[429,503], so a transient throttle must be retried with backoff and DELIVERED rather than counted rejected and the task failed. The route answers 429 once and then accepts; request_count==3 (one export read plus two POST attempts of the same batch) pins that the retry happened, and the absence of any 'rejected a batch' line plus 'Uploaded 3 of 3' pins that it succeeded. Retry-After keeps the backoff short. The persistent-rejection case (401, outside the retry list, exactly one attempt) is the upload-rejected scenario.
